No. 2: Advisory Vote to Approve Named Executive Officer Compensation
Our shareholder-approved Executive Incentive Compensation Plan ("The Plan") has been fundamental to our culture and a key driver of growth since 1985, tying compensation directly to profitability.
We encourage you to read further details of The Plan in our Compensation Discussion & Analysis.
• Since the beginning of 2021, the Compensation Committee has effectively reduced the overall allocation percentages to NEOs by 40% and has not increased the allocation to any executive position:
• RSU and PSU awards are set each May, based on Company and individual performance. Three-year PSU targets for Net Revenue and EPS are set annually and are intentionally aggressive.
The following persons are nominated to serve as Directors until the Company's 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders:

• Experience serving on audit, compensation, and nominating and governance committees with various companies.

• Director role in oversight of large- and small-scale mergers and acquisitions and sales.

How We Identify and Evaluate Director Candidates
In its process of reviewing, nominating, and selecting Director candidates:
• Committee annually reviews its nomination procedures to assess the effectiveness of the Policy on Director Nominations.
• Committee considers candidates for Director who are recommended by its members, by management, and by search firms retained by the Committee.
The Policy on Director Nominations can be found on the Company's website at https://investor.expeditors.com/
Summary of Director Nominee Experience, Qualifications, Attributes & Skills
A solid foundation in good governance practices and oversight are critical to all business operations and publicly traded companies. Many of our Directors have deep public company board experience.
The Board of Directors recommends a vote FOR the election of each of the Director Nominees.
The primary functions of Expeditors' Board of Directors include:
• Evaluating CEO and senior management performance and determining executive compensation.
